
            <div class="postcontent">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<section id="mp-md" style="-webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; text-autospace: normal; text-align: left; padding: 1em; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.75; word-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)"><p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在企业文档处理场景中，经常需要将 PDF 格式的资料转换为可编辑的演示文稿。在线转换工具存在文件上传的安全隐患，而依赖 Office 互操作的方案又需要在服务器安装完整的 Office 套件。本文分享一种基于 .NET 免费库的本地转换实现方式，全程离线处理，代码量少且易于集成。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">一、环境准备</span></h2>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1.1 安装方式</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">本文采用 Free Spire.PDF for .NET 作为转换引擎。该库独立于 Adobe Acrobat 和 Microsoft Office，可直接在 .NET 应用中完成 PDF 到 PPTX 的格式转换。免费版本支持基础转换能力，适合小规模文档处理和个人项目使用。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">通过 NuGet 安装</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">（推荐）：</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">在 Visual Studio 中打开项目，右键点击项目 → “管理 NuGet 程序包” → 浏览并搜索 </span><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; padding: 2px 4px; background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); border-radius: 2px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1)">FreeSpire.PDF</code><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">，点击安装即可。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">或在程序包管理器控制台中执行：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">PM&gt; Install-Package FreeSpire.PDF
</code></pre>
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">1.2 引入命名空间</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> Spire.Pdf;
</code></pre>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">二、核心实现代码</span></h2>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">将 PDF 转换为 PPT 的核心代码非常简洁，仅需几行：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> Spire.Pdf;
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">namespace</span> <span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(240, 100, 49, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">PDFtoPowerPoint</span><br>
{<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">class</span> <span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(240, 100, 49, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Program</span><br>
{<br>
<span class="hljs-function" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">static</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">void</span> <span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(240, 100, 49, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Main</span>(<span class="hljs-params" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span>[] <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">args</span></span>)</span><br>
{<br>
<span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 创建 PdfDocument 实例</span><br>
PdfDocument pdf = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> PdfDocument();</p>
<p><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 加载 PDF 文档</span><br>
pdf.LoadFromFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">@"C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\示例文档.pdf"</span>);</p>
</code><p><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-comment" style="color: rgba(165, 122, 76, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">// 将 PDF 转换为 PPTX 文档</span><br>
pdf.SaveToFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"PDF转PPT结果.pptx"</span>, FileFormat.PPTX);<br>
}<br>
}<br>
}<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h2 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 36px 0 24px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 24px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">三、代码详解</span></h2>

<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">带异常处理的完整版本</span></h3>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> System;
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">using</span> Spire.Pdf;
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">namespace</span> <span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(240, 100, 49, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">PDFtoPowerPoint</span><br>
{<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">class</span> <span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(240, 100, 49, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Program</span><br>
{<br>
<span class="hljs-function" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">static</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">void</span> <span class="hljs-title" style="color: rgba(240, 100, 49, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Main</span>(<span class="hljs-params" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"><span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span>[] <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">args</span></span>)</span><br>
{<br>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> inputPath = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">@"C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\示例文档.pdf"</span>;<br>
<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> outputPath = <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"PDF转PPT结果.pptx"</span>;</p>
<p><span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">try</span><br>
{<br>
PdfDocument pdf = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> PdfDocument();<br>
pdf.LoadFromFile(inputPath);<br>
pdf.SaveToFile(outputPath, FileFormat.PPTX);<br>
pdf.Close();</p>
</code><p><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">Console.WriteLine(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"转换成功！"</span>);<br>
}<br>
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">catch</span> (Exception ex)<br>
{<br>
Console.WriteLine(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">$"转换失败：<span class="hljs-subst" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">{ex.Message}</span>"</span>);<br>
}<br>
}<br>
}<br>
}<br>
</code></p></pre><p></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">四、注意事项与限制</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">⚠️ 1. 免费版的页数限制</strong></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Free Spire.PDF 作为社区版，存在以下限制：</span></p>
<ul style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 8px 0; padding-left: 20px; list-style-type: disc; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">创建和加载 PDF 文档时，文档不超过 </span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">10 页</strong></li>
<li style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; line-height: 1.6; padding-left: 0; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">将 PDF 转换为图片、Word、HTML、XPS 等格式时，仅支持转换前 </span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">3 页</strong></li>
</ul>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">2. 环境依赖</strong></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">Free Spire.PDF for .NET 是一个独立的 .NET 库，</span><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">不需要在系统上安装 Adobe Acrobat 或 Microsoft Office</strong><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0"> 即可运行。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">3. 转换质量</strong></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">转换后生成的 PPT 文档内容可以进一步编辑和修改。但对于包含复杂表格、图表或特殊字体的 PDF，建议实际测试转换效果。</span></p>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">五、进阶场景</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">1. 处理加密 PDF</strong></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">对于有密码保护的 PDF，可以在加载时提供密码：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto">pdf.LoadFromFile(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"加密文档.pdf"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"password"</span>);
</code></pre>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><strong style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; font-weight: 700; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1)">2. 批量转换</strong></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">遍历文件夹中的多个 PDF 文件，批量转换为 PPT：</span></p>
<pre style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 20px 0; padding: 0; background: rgba(246, 250, 248, 1); border-top: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-right: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(212, 229, 222, 1); border-left: 3px solid rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden"><code class="language-csharp" style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); display: block; padding: 16px 20px; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); font-family: &quot;SF Mono&quot;, Consolas, Monaco, &quot;Courier New&quot;, monospace; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; border: none; border-radius: 0; overflow-x: auto"><span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span>[] pdfFiles = Directory.GetFiles(<span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">@"C:\PDF文件夹\"</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">"*.pdf"</span>);
<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">foreach</span> (<span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">file</span> <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">in</span> pdfFiles)
{
    PdfDocument doc = <span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">new</span> PdfDocument();
    doc.LoadFromFile(<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">file</span>);
    <span class="hljs-built_in" style="color: rgba(247, 154, 50, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">string</span> output = Path.ChangeExtension(<span class="hljs-keyword" style="color: rgba(152, 103, 106, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">file</span>, <span class="hljs-string" style="color: rgba(136, 155, 74, 1); box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">".pptx"</span>);
    doc.SaveToFile(output, FileFormat.PPTX);
    doc.Close();
}
</code></pre>
<hr style="box-sizing: border-box; border: none; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0), rgba(43, 174, 133, 1), rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)); margin: 32px 0">
<h3 style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 28px 0 20px; overflow-wrap: break-word; color: rgba(43, 174, 133, 1); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.4em; word-break: break-all; font-family: &quot;PingFang SC&quot;, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Helvetica Neue&quot;, &quot;Hiragino Sans GB&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei UI&quot;, &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 20px"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">六、总结</span></h3>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 20px; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">这种本地转换方案的优势在于部署简单、数据安全、无需额外软件授权。对于内部系统集成、批量文档预处理等场景，几行代码即可完成核心能力接入。</span></p>
<p style="box-sizing: border-box; overflow-wrap: break-word; margin: 5px 0 0; line-height: 1.75em; text-align: start; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; color: rgba(44, 44, 44, 1); word-break: break-all"><span style="box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0">需要注意的是，PDF 到 PPT 的转换本质上是格式逆向还原，不存在 100% 完美还原的方案。对于排版要求严格的正式演示文稿，建议转换后进行人工校对和版式调整</span></p></section>

</div>
